context: The graph is a fixed offline snapshot of 40 YC companies. Every company node company:<slug> has exactly one IN_BATCH edge to batch:<slugify(batch)>, exactly one LOCATED_IN edge to location:<slugify(location)>, and one or two IN_INDUSTRY edges to industry:<slugify(industry tag)>. slugify lowercases the text and replaces every run of characters other than a-z or 0-9 with a single hyphen, trimming hyphens (Summer 2013 -> summer-2013; San Francisco, CA, USA -> san-francisco-ca-usa; Food and Beverage -> food-and-beverage; Engineering, Product and Design -> engineering-product-and-design). A query's answer is every company (other than the starting company) that shares at least one node with company:<slug> by the given relation. Traversal is undirected: from a company you reach its batch, location and industry nodes, and from any such node you reach every company attached to it. For each peer, via is the sorted list of every shared node id it appears under. If industry is non-empty, keep only peers with an IN_INDUSTRY edge to industry:<slugify(industry)>; if industry is empty, keep all peers. Use each company's name exactly as in the snapshot, output peers sorted by their company node id, and set count to the number of peers.
